files.description: Runnable .NET HTTP API with memory and SQL adapters
Setup, scope, run commands and cleanup
Real React component tests for loading, pending drafts, failure recovery and stale conflicts

tasks.title: Build one study planner feature across the stack
tasks.goal: Create an accessible form, HTTP contract and complete memory-backed feature.
steps: Extract the complete kit into a new practice folder.
Demonstrate a valid add and completion through React and .NET.
Reject malformed data while preserving the draft.
